newsitem.title: UK: Stg rises above three marks, first time since 1991.
newsitem.headline: Stg rises above three marks, first time since 1991.

text.p: Sterling rose above three marks for the first time since April 1991, dealers said.

Soon after, the pound eclipsed the April 1991 high of 3.0005 and pushed to 3.0010, its highest since October 1990. At 1427 GMT it was at 2.9980/90 against 2.9566/76 in late European trading on Thursday. Against the dollar it was at $1.6950/60 against $1.6882/92.
Sterling has been boosted by expectations of further UK interest rate rises to curb robust consumer demand.
The Bank of England raised UK rates by a quarter point on Thursday to 6.75 percent.
